spans.s:
(इ) जिवि r. 1st cl. (जिम्वति)
1 To please, to delight or charm.
2 To be pleased or charmed.
3 To loose.

(ऋ) जीवृ r. 1st cl. (जीवति)
To live.
With आङ्,
To use or enjoy, to get a living.
With उप,
To be dependant on for a living.
With सं or प्र,
To live agreeably.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Life, existence.
mf. (-वः-वा)
1 Livelihood, profession, specific occupation.
2 A tree: see जीवन्ती.
m. (-वः)
1 The sentient soul, the emanation of the deity, which is incorporated with the animal body, and gives it life, motion, and sensation; hence also called जीवात्मन्; it is opposed to that abstract state of the soul परमात्मन् in which by meditating upon its own divine nature and origin, the spirit is set at liberty from human feelings and passions.
2 A name of VṚ

HASPATI.
3

A name of the prince KARṆA.
f. (-वा)
1 A bow string.
2 The earth.
3 The tinkling of metallic ornaments.
4 Orris root.
5 (In Geometry,) The chord of an arc.
E.
जीव to live, affix घञ् or क, and fem. affix टाप्.

m. (-वः)
A pleasant: see जीवंजीव.

m. (-वः)
A kind of bird, supposed to be a sort of pheasant: see जीवञ्जीव.

r. 5th cl. (जिविनोति)
To seek to hurt or kill.

Time.
2

A bird.
E.
जॄ to decay, Uṇādi affix क्रिन्, and व substituted for the conversion of ऋ.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 A servant, a slave, one who gets a livelihood by service.
2 A snake-catcher, one whose business is catching snakes, curing their bites, &c.
3 An usurer, or one who lives by lending money at high interest.
4 A mendicant or one who lives by begging.
5 One whose life is prolonged by blessings.
m. (-कः)
1 A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa): see असन.
2 A medicinal plant, commonly called by the same name Jīvaka, and considered as one of the eight principal drugs, classed together under the name अष्टवर्ग.
3 An animal, any being endowed with life.
E.
जीव to live, affix ण्वुल् or वुन्.

m. (-हः)
A prisoner, one taken alive.
E.
जीव, and ग्राह capture.

m. (-बः)
1 A kind of bird, supposed to be a pheasant.
5 The Cakora or Greek partridge.
3 A kind of tree.
E.
जीव life, and जीव who lives, from जीव with खच् affix, long-lived.

mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्)
Living, alive.
E.
जीव to live, शतृ aff.

f. (-का)
A woman whose children are living.
E.
जीवत् living, and तोक offspring.

f. (-तिः)
A wife whose husband is alive.
E.
जीवत् living, and पति a husband.

m. (-कः)
A son whose father is alive.
E.
जीवत्, and पितृ a father, कन् added.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
1 Virtuous, pious.
2 Long-lived.
m. (-थः)
Virtue, piety.
2 Life, existence.
3 A cloud.
4 A peacock.
5 A tortoise.
E.
जीव to live, अथ Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Life-giving, who or what gives life.
m. (-दः)
1 A physician, a practitioner of medicine.
2 An enemy.
E.
जीव life, and द in the first sense, from दा to give, in the second, from दो to destroy, affix ड.

n. (-नं)
Living property, live-stock, wealth in flocks and herds.
E.
जीव alive, and धन wealth.

m. (-नः)
1 A plant, commonly Jiuti, (Odina wodier.)
2 A son.
3 A living being, an animal.
f. (-ना or गी)
A plant, commonly Jiyati: see जीवन्ती.
f. (-नी)
Jasmin.
n. (-नं)
1 Life, existence.
2 Livelihood, profession.
3

Water.
4

Butter of new or one day-old milk.
5 Marrow.
E.
जीव to live, affix ल्यु or ल्युट्.

m. (-कः)
Food, especially boiled rice.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-नं)
Disappointment of all hopes, living in vain.
E.
जीवन, and विडम्वन frustrating.

m. (-निः)
Communication of vitality with body.
E.
जीवम, and योनि origin.

m. (-तुः)
End or object of life, the cause of living.
E.
जीवन, and हेतु cause.

n. (-तं)
Poison.
E.
जीवन life, and आघात destroying.

m. (-न्तः)
Death.
E.
जीवन, and अन्त end.

m. (-सः)
VARUṆA, regent of water.
E.
जीवन water, and आवास abode.

n. (-यं)
Water.
f. (-या)
Jiyati: see जीवन्ती.
E.
जीवन life, छ affix; being friendly or necessary to existence.

m. (-यः)
Livelihood, means of subsistence.
E.
जीवन and उपाय means.

n. (-धं)
A drug to revive the dead.
E.
जीवन living, and औषध a medicament.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं)
Living, existent.
m. (-न्तः)
1 Life, existence.
2 A medicament, a drug.
f. (-न्ती)
1 The name of a tree, commonly Jiyati, (Celtis orientalis.)
2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum): see गुडूची.
3 The Śami or Sāen tree, (Mimosa albida.)
4 A parasite plant.
5 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula, Rox.)
E.
जीव to live, affix झच्; fem. affix ङीप्; also with कन् added जीवन्तिका, &c.

m. (-कः)
A fowler, a bird-catcher: see जीवान्तक.
f. (-का)
1 A parasite plant, (Epidendron tesseloides,) and other species.
3 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
3 A kind of potherb.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-क्तः)
A man purified by knowledge of BRAHMA, and exonerated whilst living from future birth, and all ritual ceremonies.
E.
जीवत्, and मुक्त freed.

f. (-क्तिः)
Acquirement of spiritual knowledge, and consequent liberation from future birth, and ritual acts.
E.
जीवत्, and मुक्ति liberation.

m. (-कः)
1 A tree, commonly

Ingua.
2
A different plant bearing seeds which are used in rosaries, commonly Jiyaputa, (Nageia putranjiva.)

m. (-धः)
Destruction of living beings.
E.
जीव, and बध killing.

m. (-रः)
The body.
E.
जीव life, and मन्दिर mansion.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Alive, endowed with life.
E.
जीव, and भूत become.

n. (-कं)
1 The world, the habitation of living beings.
2 Mankind.
E.
जीव, and लोक world.

n. (-नं)
Rice, grain.
E.
जीव, and साधन means.

n. (-ल्यं)
Realisation of all one's wishes.
E.
जीव, and साफल्य fruitfulness.

f. (-सूः)
The mother of living offspring.
E.
जीव living, and सू bringing forth.

n. (-नं)
A joint, an articulation.
E.
जीव life, and स्थान place.

m. (-रः)
The material and visible world.
E.
जीव animate, and अजीव inanimate, आधार a support.

mn. (-तुः-तु)
1 A drug for reanimating the dead.
2 Boiled rice, food.
3 Life, existence.
E.
जीव life, आतु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-त्मा)
The vital principle or spirit; that spiritual essence which renders bodies susceptible of motion or sensation.
E.
जीव life, and आत्मन् soul or spirit.

m. (-रः)
The world.
E.
जीव an animal, and आधार support.

m. (-कः)
1 A fowler, a bird-catcher.
2 A destroyer of life, a slayer, a murderer.
E.
जीव a living being, and अन्तक a destroyer; also sometimes written जीवन्तक.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Hoping for life.
f. (-शा)
Hope of living.
E.
जीव, and आशा hope.

f. (-का)
1 Livelihood, profession or occupation by which a subsistence is obtained.
2 A tree: see जीवन्ती.
E.
जीव to live, ण्वुल् and टाप् affixes: see जीवक.

mf. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Having obtained subsistence.
E.
जीविका, and आपन्न obtained.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Having obtained as a livelihood.
E.
जीविका, and प्राप्त obtained.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Living, alive, existent.
n. (-तं)
Living, life, existence.
E.
जीव, and क्त aff.

n. (-लं)
Period or duration of life, a life.
E.
जीवित existence, and काल time.

f. (-ज्ञा)
An artery, a vessel of the body.
E.
जीवित, and ज्ञा what knows.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be lived, to be kept alive.
E.
जीव, and तव्य aff.

m. (-यः)
Casting away life.
E.
जीवित, and व्यय expense.

m. (-यः)
Fear of death.
E.
जीवित, and संशय doubt.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Destroying life.
E.
जीवित, and हारिन् what takes away.

f. (-शा)
Love of life.
E.
जीवित, and आशा hope.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Ruling life, master of being, (applicable to objects either of reverence or affection.)
m. (-शः)
1 A name of YAMA, regent of death.
2 The sun.
3 The moon.
4 A lover, a husband.
5 Lord or master of existence.
6 A drug to revive the dead.
E.
जीवित life, and ईश lord, ruler.

m. (-र्गः)
Abandonment of life, voluntary death.
E.
जीव, and उत्सर्ग leaving.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Alive, living, animate, a living being.
E.
जीव, and इनि aff.
